populate_scene_with_robot: populate a MuJoCo kitchen scene with a robot from MuJoCo Menagerie
run_populate_scene_g1: run populate_scene with the g1 robot to generate a populated kitchen model
run_populate_scene_custom_input: run populate_scene with a custom input scene and output filename

run_populate_scene_custom_robot: run populate_scene with a custom robot type from MuJoCo Menagerie
